context_summary: Batch planning of 3 independent features: F51 (fix explore cards images/prices + refresh), F52 (fix dashboard trending regression), F53 (Pila easter eggs with gaucho dialogues). All P2 QoL features are shipped (F49-F50). These 3 features address UX gaps, a regression bug, and a fun engagement feature for PILA currency users.

options_considered.description: Plan all 3 features in parallel (F51, F52, F53) — they are fully independent.
pros: F51 fixes real UX issues (missing images/prices) that affect user experience
F52 fixes a regression bug — trending section was working before recent refactors
F53 adds cultural engagement for Brazilian gaúcho users (core audience)
All 3 are independent — can be planned and executed in parallel
cons: 3 features in parallel increases review burden
F53 is cosmetic/fun — lower priority than bug fixes

options_considered.description: Only plan F51+F52 (bug fixes), defer F53.
pros: Focus on fixing broken functionality first
cons: F53 is user-requested and adds engagement value

rationale: All 3 features are independent, user-requested, and address different concerns (UX fix, bug fix, engagement). Planning in parallel maximizes throughput. F51+F52 are bug fixes that should ship ASAP. F53 is a fun cultural feature that enhances the PILA currency experience.
